title: Tensor bounds for any representative over a constant field sheaf
statement: On a small site [def-weil-size-convention], let k be a field [def-weil-field], R its associated constant commutative ring sheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], and C an object of the standard derived category of R-module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], with homology in [a,b]. For every complex P with Q(P) isomorphic to C and every R-module sheaf N, the signed total tensor P⊗N[0] [def-weil-pbc-ringed-koszul-system] has homology zero outside [a,b]. No K-flatness hypothesis on P is needed.

proof.text: Every module sheaf over the associated constant field sheaf is flat. Compare the site sheaf tensor and the monoidal tensor to deduce exactness of tensorRight N.

The standard localization homology comparison and Q(P)≅C give bounds for P. The single-factor total comparison identifies P⊗N[0] with termwise tensorRight N. Exact tensor commutes with homology and takes zero to zero.

proof_origin.place: Immersion lifting input: explicit residue, field tensor, lisse transport, or completed restriction step
